“所谓仪轨，本质上是对世界规律的一种客观总结。”

“或者你可以说，它是对零散规律的汇总。”

“正是因为规律的‘零散性’、‘随机性’，再加上主导仪轨实际效果的‘神秘力量’的不稳定性，在过去数千年时间里，人类从来没有真正在这门科学上形成稳定的体系、稳定的传承。”

“但即便如此，依托宗教这种BUG级别的文化传承载体，我们也仍然保留了相当一部分法脉传承。”

“而这些法脉传承，也大致上被划分出了类别、划分出了品级.....”

坐在桌前，林舒沉下心来认真听着陆染的讲解。

一边在白纸上写写画画，陆染一边继续说道：

“目前，我们对‘仪轨’的分类也大体是沿袭宗教体系里原有的品级。”

“这么做的目的一方面是为了尽可能保留原有体系的完整性、避免遗漏可用仪轨。”

“另一方面则是因为，这套体系的可扩展性较强，即使后续我们发现了更多‘体系之外’的仪轨，也可以轻易地将其归类到原有体系中，形成完整的、有序的管理。”

“这套体系，我们把它叫做‘三洞九品体系’。”

“其来源是来自道教《天坛玉格》的九品迁转制，以及三洞经教体系的‘三洞大类’。”

“九品很好理解，直接当成等级就好，一品最低，九品最高----当然我们平时聊的时候经常说的是一级二级，而不是一品二品，因为‘品’这个字在现代语境下说起来总有点怪怪的。”

“但意思是一样的----保留这个‘品’字，实际上是保持对原有体系来源的敬畏。”

话音落下，林舒若有所思地点了点头。

确实。

虽然意思一样，但说“几品”，总有点玄幻小说里功法的感觉。

但说“等级”，就多了几分严谨、科学的味道。

“明白了，你继续说。”

“好。”

陆染翻过一页，继续边写边说道：

“在品级的基础上，我们横向把所有仪轨分成了三大类。”

“即洞玄部、洞神部、洞真部。”

“之所以这么分类，是因为三洞经教的分类本身就很严格，并且契合仪轨的基础分类标准。”

“你可能以为三洞的区别是简单的法术分类，但实际上，它更像是一个把神明、典籍、修行阶段与法术权限深度融合的、等级森严的完整宇宙法则体系。”

“三洞本身也是有高低之分的，比如洞真部，传统道教典籍就认为，这是‘大乘圣道’，而洞玄部则只是‘中乘妙法’。”

“不过在我们的分类法中，我们摒弃了三洞之间的高低分别，只取它在‘规则权限划分’上的差异。”

“这中间的分类非常复杂，你甚至可以参考生物学上那种界、门、纲、目、科、属、种的分类逻辑。”

“但目前来说，你不需要真的记住每一种仪轨的分类，只需要记住分类的大原则就好了。”

“洞神部，主要收纳‘现象’类别的仪轨，雷法、呼风唤雨法、包括梅山的各种符水术、苗疆蛊术----我指的是仪轨体系下的蛊术，而不是现在还在流传的那种毒术----都属于这个类别。”

“洞玄部，主要收录‘规则’类别的仪轨，平安符就属于这个分类，另外还包括诸如五鬼运财、五猖法、八威策文法等等。”

"The so-called ritual is essentially an objective summary of the laws of the world."

"Or you could say it's a collection of scattered patterns."

"It is precisely because of the 'scattered' and 'random' nature of the laws, coupled with the instability of the 'mysterious power' that dominates the actual effects of rituals, that over the past thousands of years, humans have never really formed a stable system or stable inheritance in this science."

"But even so, relying on religion, a BUG-level cultural inheritance carrier, we still retain a considerable part of the inheritance of the law."

"And these inheritance of Dharma lineage have been roughly divided into categories and grades..."

Sitting at the table, Lin Shu calmed down and listened carefully to Lu Ran's explanation.

While writing and drawing on the white paper, Lu Ran continued:

"Currently, our classification of 'rituals' generally follows the original grades in the religious system."

“The purpose of this is to preserve the integrity of the original system as much as possible and avoid missing available rituals.”

"On the other hand, it is because this system is highly scalable. Even if we later discover more rituals 'outside the system', we can easily classify them into the original system to form a complete and orderly management."

"We call this system the 'three holes and nine levels system'."

"The source is the nine-grade transfer system from the Taoist "Temple of Heaven Jade Grid" and the "three-hole category" of the three-hole scripture system."

"Ninth grade is easy to understand. Just think of it as a level. First grade is the lowest and ninth grade is the highest. Of course, when we talk, we often talk about first and second grades, not first and second grades, because the word 'grade' always sounds a bit weird in a modern context."

"But the meaning is the same - retaining the word 'pin' actually means maintaining respect for the source of the original system."

After the words fell, Lin Shu nodded thoughtfully.

really.

Although the meaning is the same, when talking about "several grades", it always feels a bit like the skills in fantasy novels.

But when talking about "level", it has a more rigorous and scientific flavor.

"I understand, please continue."

"Okay."

Lu Ran turned over a page and continued writing:

"On the basis of grade, we horizontally divided all rituals into three major categories."

"That is, the Dongxuan Department, the Dongshen Department, and the Dongzhen Department."

"The reason for this classification is because the classification of Sandong Jingjiao is very strict and conforms to the basic classification standards of rituals."

"You may think that the difference between the three holes is a simple classification of spells, but in fact, it is more like a complete and hierarchical cosmic law system that deeply integrates gods, classics, practice stages and spell authority."

"The three caves themselves are also divided into high and low levels. For example, the Dongzhen Department, traditional Taoist books believe that this is the 'Mahayana Sacred Path', while the Dongxuan Department is only the 'Middle Vehicle Wonderful Dharma'."

"However, in our classification, we abandoned the distinction between the three holes and only took the differences in the 'division of rules and authority'."

"The classification is very complicated. You can even refer to the biological classification logic of kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus and species."

"But for now, you don't really need to remember the classification of each ritual, you just need to remember the general principles of classification."

"The Cave God Department mainly contains the rituals of the 'phenomenon' category. Thunder magic, summoning wind and rain, including Meishan's various talisman magic, and Miaojiang Gu magic - I refer to the poison magic under the ritual system, not the poisonous magic that is still circulating now - all belong to this category."

"The Dongxuan Department mainly contains rituals in the 'rules' category. The Peace Talisman belongs to this category. It also includes things like the Five Ghosts to Luck Wealth, the Five Rampant Methods, the Eight Powerful Grammars, etc."
